S01: The young Englishman Robinson Crusoe dreamed of distant seas and great adventures.
S02: Robinson: "Hey! I'm sailing off in search of adventure!"
S03: The first days at sea were calm, the sky clear and the water tranquil.
S04: But suddenly, the sky darkened and the waves rose.
S05: A terrible storm seized the ship with great waves and fierce winds.
S06: With a crash, the mast broke.
S07: The ship sank in the storm, and Robinson remained the sole survivor.
S08: Clinging to a piece of wood, he surrendered to the current.
S09: The current carried him toward a distant island in the middle of the ocean.
S10: When he awoke, he lay on a lonely beach.
S11: Around him there was no one — only plants and trees.
S12: Yet Robinson did not give up — he resolved to survive.
S13: He built a hut while waiting for someone to come rescue him.
S14: From branches and leaves he raised his home.
S15: The days passed, and he waited for rescue.
S16: In the hut, he marked the days and waited.
S17: One morning, walking along the beach, he saw something strange.
S18: A human footprint — larger than his own.
S19: His heart beat hard — he was not alone on the island.
S20: Then he heard voices and realized he was not the only human on the island.
S21: He hid behind bushes and looked.
S22: He saw several natives binding another native.
S23: They left him alone, helpless, and departed.
S24: When they were gone, Robinson approached him.
S27: From that day, they became inseparable friends.
S28: They shared work, food and hope.
S29: Together they hunted, fished and laughed.
S31: Robinson never stopped gazing toward the horizon.
S33: Robinson: "A ship! Look, Petko — a ship!"
S36: They immediately set out toward the beach.
S37: There they saw sailors who had left three bound officers on the sand and gone into the thicket.
S38: Captain: "I am the captain of the ship. My sailors have mutinied."
S39: Robinson: "We will help you take back your ship!"
S40: During the night, Robinson and Petko swam to the ship.
S42: The mutineers walked the deck without knowing.
S43: One by one, they seized the mutineers.
S44: They locked them in the cargo hold.
S46: Robinson: "We must say goodbye, Petko." Petko: "I'm coming with you to England!"
S47: After several weeks at sea, land appeared.
S48: Dressed in new clothes, they disembarked at the port.
